---
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      api_purpose:
        description: Explicit API baseline purpose; release validation requires published.
        type: string
        default: published
    outputs:
      candidate_sha:
        description: Exact candidate whose complete selected checks succeeded.
        value: ${{ jobs.pr-gate.outputs.candidate_sha }}
      published_api_candidate_sha:
        description: Exact candidate with successful published-purpose API validation.
        value: ${{ jobs.pr-gate.outputs.published_api_candidate_sha }}

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  statuses: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  validation-plan:
    name: Validation plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      plan: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.plan }}
      profile: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.profile }}
      select_rust: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_rust }}
      select_msrv: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_msrv }}
      select_dependencies: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_dependencies }}
      select_documentation: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_documentation }}
      select_lockfile_release_age: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact tested candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out trusted policy revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          path: _policy
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable implementation identity
        env:
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
        run: test "$(git -C _automation rev-parse HEAD)" = "${AUTOMATION_SHA}"
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Select exact candidate checks from trusted base policy
        id: plan
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci plan \
            --repository-root . --config _policy/scripts/validation-policy.json \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --github-output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  rust:
    name: Rust quality
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_rust == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/shared-rust-api.yml
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      api_purpose: ${{ inputs.api_purpose || 'development' }}
  msrv:
    name: Minimum supported Rust
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_msrv == 'true'
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-ci.yml@5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      task: msrv

  dependencies:
    name: Dependency and license policy
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_dependencies == 'true'
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-dependencies.yml@5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json

  documentation:
    name: Repository files and documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_documentation == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact tested repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out trusted documentation policy
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          path: _policy
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out canonical shared development tools
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Read Node runtime from the sole shared version inventory
        id: shared-node
        run: |
          version="$(sed -n 's/^FROM docker.io\/library\/node:\([0-9.]*\)-bookworm-slim@sha256:.*/\1/p' _automation/.devcontainer/Dockerfile)"
          [[ "${version}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          printf 'version=%s\n' "${version}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Install the shared pinned Node runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.shared-node.outputs.version }}
      - name: Provision only repository-check tools from the shared immutable inventory
        run: bash scripts/setup-ci-tools.sh _automation
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Check Python formatting
        run: uv run --locked --project _automation/automation ruff format --check .
      - name: Lint Python automation
        run: uv run --locked --project _automation/automation ruff check .
      - name: Type-check Python automation
        run: uv run --locked --project _automation/automation ty check
      - name: Extract the immutable official Renovate runtime with its actual RE2 engine
        if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.profile != 'prose'
        run: bash scripts/install-renovate-tool.sh
      - name: Run selected documentation checks from trusted policy
        env:
          TASK: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.profile == 'prose' && 'documentation-prose' || 'documentation' }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci run \
            --repository-root . --config _policy/scripts/validation-policy.json \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" --task "${TASK}" \
            --report-json .ci-tools/reports/documentation.json --summary "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

  lockfile-release-age:
    name: Dependency eligibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age == 'true'
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-dependency-wait.yml@5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}

  pr-gate:
    name: Required CI
    if: always()
    needs: [validation-plan, rust, msrv, dependencies, documentation, lockfile-release-age]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.candidate_sha }}
      published_api_candidate_sha: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.published_api_candidate_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact tested candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out trusted policy revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          path: _policy
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable implementation identity
        env:
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
        run: test "$(git -C _automation rev-parse HEAD)" = "${AUTOMATION_SHA}"
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Require every selected check and only planned skips
        id: gate
        env:
          PLAN_JSON: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          API_PURPOSE: ${{ inputs.api_purpose || 'development' }}
          PUBLISHED_API_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ needs.rust.outputs.published_api_candidate_sha }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 5b4deb3fa2e06a0eea1643bbbdecec34e18b1281
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci gate \
            --repository-root . --config _policy/scripts/validation-policy.json \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --plan-json "${PLAN_JSON}" --needs-json "${NEEDS_JSON}"
          case "${API_PURPOSE}" in
            published)
              test "${PUBLISHED_API_CANDIDATE_SHA}" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
              printf 'published_api_candidate_sha=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
              ;;
            development) ;;
            *) exit 1 ;;
          esac
          printf 'candidate_sha=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
